title.text: Emotions and the decision not to

why_how.text: Keep this rule in mind: If you are worried, distracted or preoccupied you cannot count on being alert enough to drive safely, and troubles at home, quarrels, financial worries, serious family illness, personal fears or overconfidence can make you temporarily crash-prone.

Keep this rule in mind: A person who has just had a violent argument, or who is angry or grieving, needs some cooling-off time before driving, because taking out frustration or anger on the road is very poor judgment and an expensive way to vent emotion.
